title: 2026 Asian Games medal table
headline: 2026 Asian Games medal table
dek: The Asian Games are running in Aichi and Nagoya, Japan, until 4 October.
whatItIs: The running count of gold, silver and bronze medals won by each country at the 2026 Asian Games.
whyNow: The Asian Games are running in Aichi and Nagoya, Japan, until 4 October. People check the medal table like a league table: every day, and more often as the finals pile up in the last week.
